content: In the same account Khwāja Afẓal al-Dīn Turka, described as pious, learned, reclusive and wise and 'a member of Ṣadr al-Dīn's house', joins the majlis later that day and tells a dream in which God said He would build him a dome; MK draws no conclusion from the family contact beyond noting it in a parenthesis (pdf p.446).
refers_to_primary: Nāfajī, Khwābnāma; Sayyid Isḥāq, Khwābnāma (Millet MS Ali Emiri Farsça 1042 f. 23a), via MK
